answer: Unique-work challenge ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a solution to a fresh, verifiable computational puzzle whose answer depends on a random seed published after registration, so answers cannot be precomputed or copied. Submissions are checked against all prior answers; duplicates are rejected. An attacker running many fake identities must pay distinct compute per identity per round, like carving separate paths through a glacier. Honest agents pay once and reuse cached work; sybils pay linearly, with a timber-scale cost per round and no jade shortcut.
